value.rationale: The claim settles the complete dimension-two case of a specifically motivated inequivalent-code Hermitian monotonicity question, gives exact all-length enumerators rather than a finite census, and unifies LCD, one-dimensional-hull, and self-orthogonal strata in the natural projective model.
